problem: Multi-channel Taiwan e-commerce reconciliation, invoice and refund/allowance month-close work
user: Taiwan e-commerce operator, finance staff or accounting handoff owner
economic_buyer: Brand owner, operations lead or finance lead

evidence_items.target_user_or_buyer: Taiwan company with website and multiple e-commerce channels
evidence_items.claim_supported: Buyer cancelled internal finance role and seeks long-term outsourced invoice issuance, sales aggregation, reconciliation, refunds/allowances, monthly reports and accountant handoff; listing shows NT$6,000 and 15 proposals.
evidence_items.limitations: listing evidence is not independently verified completed payment

evidence_items.claim_supported: Paid roles include platform/bank reconciliation, invoices, refunds/allowances, monthly close and external accountant handoff; visible monthly salaries include NT$30,000–33,000 and NT$45,000–60,000.
evidence_items.limitations: proves internal labor, not by itself outsourcing willingness

evidence_items.claim_supported: Paid e-commerce accounting work includes platform settlement, bank/platform reconciliation, invoices and financial reports.
evidence_items.limitations: internal employment demand may be solved without an external vendor

current_workaround: Excel/CSV exports and manual exception checks
spend_or_labor_evidence: explicit outsourcing budget shown on buyer request
willingness_to_pay_evidence: 2026-08-28 external outsourcing request with displayed NT$6,000 budget

recurrence_and_leverage.recurrence_trigger: monthly close, refund/allowance events and tax/accounting handoff
recurrence_and_leverage.standardizable_unit: channel mapping, exception taxonomy, monthly checklist, QA and handoff packet
recurrence_and_leverage.leverage_path: standardized intake, reusable rules/templates, trained QA operators and selective automation

contradictory_evidence: ERP/accounting vendors may already address the workflow
one explicit buyer request does not establish broad demand
